# ILua.DoString method

Runs *chunk* in the game's main Lua state on the calling (main) thread. Fire-and-forget: no return value. Wrap the chunk body in `pcall(function() ... end)` so a Lua-side error cannot propagate back through the interop trampoline. No-op until [`Ready`](./Ready.md).
